sentences.text: For the directions at paragraph 261(1) and 261(2), the source of funds used for pre-payment does not matter, because they apply irrespective of the source of funds used for pre-payment, either in part or in full, and without any minimum lock-in period.
The evidence does not show any source-of-funds condition for paragraph 260, and paragraph 261(5) says other cases fall under a UCB's approved policy.
